notes.title: Pix Early Access update! (v0.8)
notes.content:
Been watching people play on YouTube / Twitch, and tweaked a few levels as a result.

What's new:

- Level 004 Level Tweak (people kept bumping head on ceiling in sticky spots)
- Level 005 Level & Art Tweak (less head bumping, new colors / designs)

notes.title: Pix Early Access update! (v0.7)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30454715/91d0aa645523b02d9be3dd9fe19217a9747d3855.png[/img]

Thanks everyone for the feedback! We added new items to the "to do" list in response to your early feedback. Much appreciated!

Now for the new update - what's new:

- Level 014 Level tweak (there was a tight spot, tricky to get out of)
- Level 019 Art Tweak
- Level 036 Optimized
- Revised "TO DO" list following your suggestions!
